title: Evidenced value
description: A single fact with its provenance. Every number that enters the valuation carries a status so the assessment can show how load-bearing it is. Pattern borrowed from journeykit's evidence atoms.

value.description: The fact itself (number, string, boolean). null is allowed only with status 'fehlend'.

status.description: belegt = quoted from a source; geschaetzt = derived by a model or a person from evidence; angenommen = default/assumption without object-specific evidence; fehlend = unknown.

kind.description: Source quality tier. 'amtlich' (official register/statistics) ranks above 'portal'/'makler' (interest-driven).

document.description: File name or document title, e.g. 'Expose_2026-10-01.pdf'

quote.description: Verbatim text span the value was taken from. Mandatory for status 'belegt'.
